definitions: A rule in sports, especially football (soccer), that penalises an attacking player who is in an illegal position (nearer to the opponent's goal line than both the ball and the second-to-last opponent) when the ball is played to them.
The regulation governing when a player is considered to be in an offside position and subject to a penalty.
examples: The referee applied the offside rule.
Understanding the offside rule is crucial.
They debated the interpretation of the offside rule.
